sections.title: Not every friend is the same kind of friend
sections.content: You already have barát from A1. barátnő adds -nő the way kolléganő does. ismerős ("acquaintance") is someone you know, but not closely — a useful middle ground between barát and stranger.

items.spanish: Petra nem csak kolléganőm, hanem barátnőm is.
items.english: Petra isn't just my colleague, she's also my friend.

items.spanish: Ő csak egy ismerős, nem közeli barát.
items.english: He's just an acquaintance, not a close friend.

sections.content: nem csak... hanem... is ("not only... but also...") is a useful new pattern for exactly this kind of situation — someone who's more than one thing to you at once.
